title: Wire Codex dedup, incremental rescan, and doctor
description:
Wire the shared frameworks into the Codex adapter: dedup the same rollout in sessions and archived_sessions by session_meta id; in forked/resumed rollouts skip inherited items using forked_from_id and forked_from_ordinal_exclusive (resumed/forked rollouts re-record inherited context — inherited human messages must count once), with the content-tuple dedup fallback absorbing residue; incremental watermarks per the append-only JSONL policy; doctor checks reporting the observed codex-cli versions.

Done when: a fixture resumed rollout counts inherited messages exactly once; archived duplicates count once; rescan equals cold scan; doctor runs on a real Mac.
